name: Behavioral property
description: Behavioral material properties manifest only in specific circumstances: yield strength is the material's behavior under mechanical stress, realized in a mechanical process. The property is a specifically dependent continuant borne by the material and given a value by a scalar value specification.
competency_questions: Which properties of a material show themselves only under particular circumstances? In which process is a behavioral property realized? What value and unit specify a behavioral property such as yield strength or melting point?
